heading: Dividends
lead: Dividends may be payable only on nonvoting investment stock, if declared by the board of directors of the bank, subject to the general direction of the Farm Credit Administration.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1988—Pub. L. 100–233 struck out “other than stock held by the Farm Credit Administration,” after “investment stock,”. 1985—Pub. L. 99–205 struck out “the Governor of” before “the Farm Credit Administration” and inserted “, subject to the general direction of the Farm Credit Administration”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1985 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 99–205 effective thirty days after Dec. 23, 1985, see section 401 of Pub. L. 99–205, set out as a note under section 2001 of this title.
